answer_1.quote: We propose PPTAGENT, a framework that redefines automatic presentation generation as an edit-based process guided by reference presentations.
answer_1.outputs: Presentations with text, images, and structured layouts

answer_2.quote: We evaluated the presentation generation using the following metrics: • Success Rate (SR) ... • Perplexity (PPL) ... • Rouge-L ... • FID ... • PPTEVAL ...

answer_3.quote: We propose PPTEVAL, which adopts the MLLM-as-a-judge paradigm to evaluate presentations across three dimensions: Content, Design, and Coherence.

answer_4.quote: We recruited four graduate students through a Shanghai-based crowdsourcing platform to evaluate a total of 250 presentations...
answer_4.guideline: Following the evaluation framework proposed by PPTEVAL, assessments were conducted across three dimensions using the scoring criteria detailed in Appendix F.
